claims.claim: pyproject.toml defines an installable Python 3.11+ package with an aios-node console script entry point backed by the aios_node package.
Host core deterministically derives READY when configured dependencies and state directory are valid, and DEGRADED with stable bounded reason codes when dependencies are missing or not executable.
Readiness probing checks only host-local executable availability and state-storage capability without invoking AIOS-renew, Antigravity, Codex, Git, models, network requests, or project verification.
Host state is persisted as strict UTF-8 JSON via atomic same-directory replacement containing schema version, operational state, bounded reasons, and process id without canonical engineering fields.
Host process executes a non-polling idle lifecycle blocked on OS wait and handles SIGINT/SIGTERM gracefully without launching an AIOS RUN, Executor, retry, recovery, or child work.
Host core enforces operational states READY and DEGRADED, rejects local emission of BUSY or OFFLINE, and contains no device-specific paths or Termux service policies.
Standard-library unit tests verify READY, DEGRADED, atomic state persistence, deterministic reason codes, and stoppable idle lifecycle without real model, network, or process side effects.
